title: Stop Linux update loops and protect user-installed Node environments.
changes: Fix the systemd launcher global npm prefix when the saved ReMCP CLI path points directly inside the installed npm package. An update can no longer nest a new client under the old package while restarting the stale service.
Reject package-nested npm prefixes before package writes, and verify the exact client/runtime release pair at the managed-service path before restarting a pinned automatic update.
Keep other nvm, FNM, Homebrew and system Node/npm installations untouched by automatic synchronization; only the active managed ReMCP service remains a required installation target.
Make Linux automatic updates opt-in (remcp auto-update on) while honoring explicit saved preferences. Manual updates remain available, and macOS/Windows defaults are unchanged.
Add Linux prefix and restart regression tests, preserve legacy manual update and macOS/Windows service lifecycle behavior, and verify the CLI/runtime with an isolated npm prefix on ASUS.
